name: Fire Station (Emergency Vehicle)
spec: yellow diamond with a black fire-truck symbol
meaning: Emergency vehicles may enter the road ahead.

snippets.back: Skip U-turns at posted signs, on crossings, over dividers and twin double yellows, under two-hundred-foot sight, on one-ways, at fire stations and driveways, in business blocks except intersections and openings.
Hold at least twenty feet back from a fire station entrance.
As soon as you see or hear an emergency vehicle signaling, get as close to the road edge as you can, keep out of intersections and stay stopped until it passes.
Keep twenty feet from a fire station driveway on your side of the street, and seventy-five feet from it on the opposite side when marked.
Do not park within fifteen feet of a fire hydrant or of a fire station entrance.
Do not park within twenty feet of a fire station driveway, or within seventy-five feet of the entrance on the opposite side of the street.
Never make a U-turn in front of a fire station or use a fire station driveway to turn around.

Parking or standing is prohibited in front of a driveway, within twenty feet of an intersection crosswalk, within thirty feet of a traffic light, stop sign, or yield sign, within twenty feet of a fire station driveway or seventy-five feet on the opposite side, and along a cut or lowered curb, while parking is prohibited within fifty feet of a railroad crossing.

result.summary: No snippet describes sign shape/color or states that sign warns emergency vehicles may enter; snippets only give parking and U-turn rules near fire stations.
